regle: When a moved passage carries revisions by another author: at the source, nest their insertions in the moveFrom (text in w:t) and leave their deletions beside it; in the copy, do not duplicate their revisions (freeze them, on the user's decision); give new identifiers to the copied revisions; check validate.py --original --author AND the exact rejection (docx_couches) before delivery.
source: 15_renumerotation_references: moves faithful to Word (the other author's revisions nested and duplicated in the copy) passed the exact check (rejection = source) but failed the tracked-changes check of the docx skill, which matches revisions by author, date and text, and makes visible on rejection all the deleted text contained in a moveFrom.
titre: Tracked move of a passage that carries another author's revisions: test against the tracked-changes check before delivering
